title: ECHO: Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators for Distillation-Guided 100K-Sequence Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.28569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling lifetime user behavior sequences is essential for capturing long-range preferences in industrial recommendation, yet 100K-length user sequences make target-aware ranking prohibitively expensive. Search-based methods that retrieve from raw sequences incur candidate-dependent costs that grow with sequence length, whereas latent compression methods reduce computation at the expense of item-level addressability. We propose ECHO (Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators), a framework that balances efficiency and fine-grained retrieval by retaining a subset of original event records per user via a Distilled Selector (DS) and retrieving a smaller set of target-relevant records per candidate via a Target-aware Fine-grained Retriever (TFR). DS is supervised by a candidate-aware full-history teacher via per-target distillation, enabling target-aware user-level selection without incurring full-history computation for every candidate. T

translated_title: ECHO：面向蒸馏引导的10万长度序列建模的同构算子高效级联框架
translated_abstract: 对用户终身行为序列进行建模对于捕捉工业推荐系统中的长期偏好至关重要，然而10万长度（100K）的用户序列使得目标感知的排序计算代价高得难以承受。从原始序列中检索的基于搜索的方法会产生随序列长度增长且依赖候选物品的计算开销，而潜在压缩方法则以牺牲物品级的可寻址性为代价来降低计算量。我们提出ECHO（Efficient Cascade with Homogeneous Operators，同构算子高效级联）框架，它通过蒸馏选择器（DS）为每个用户保留一个原始事件记录子集，并通过目标感知细粒度检索器（TFR）为每个候选物品检索一个更小的目标相关记录集合，从而在效率与细粒度检索之间取得平衡。DS由具备候选感知能力的全历史教师模型通过逐目标蒸馏进行监督，实现了目标感知的用户级选择，而无需为每个候选执行全历史计算。TFR……
tldr: 提出ECHO级联框架，利用蒸馏选择器（DS）和目标感知细粒度检索器（TFR）两级结构，在10万长度用户行为序列上实现高效且保持物品级可寻址性的目标感知推荐排序建模。
en_tdlr: ECHO is an efficient cascaded framework combining a Distilled Selector and a Target-aware Fine-grained Retriever that enables target-aware ranking over 100K-length user behavior sequences while preserving item-level fine-grained addressability for industrial recommendation.
